[British, informal] They're in the boozer most nights. 2. countable noun A boozer is a person who drinks a lot of alcohol. [informal] I thought he was a bit of a boozer. Synonyms: drinker, toper [literary], drunk, soak [slang] More Synonyms of boozer More Synonyms of boozer Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner’s Dictionary.
